description.fr-FR: Trente-trois petites pièces de Jean Eudes : le Memoriale beneficiorum Dei, le Vœu, les mémoires et requêtes, la Protestation de haine contre le péché, le Contrat d’une sainte alliance avec la Vierge, la Lettre à la très sainte Vierge, le Testament, des exhortations, des maximes, et l’Office et la Messe du Bienheureux.
description.en-US: Thirty-three short pieces by John Eudes: the Memoriale beneficiorum Dei, the Vow, memoirs and petitions, the Protestation of hatred against sin, the Contract of a holy alliance with the Virgin, the Letter to the Most Holy Virgin, the Testament, exhortations, maxims, and the Office and Mass of the Blessed John Eudes.
description.pt-BR: Trinta e três pequenas peças de João Eudes: o Memoriale beneficiorum Dei, o Voto, memoriais e petições, o Protesto de ódio ao pecado, o Contrato de santa aliança com a Virgem, a Carta à santíssima Virgem, o Testamento, exortações, máximas, e o Ofício e a Missa do Beato João Eudes.

fr-FR.editor: Charles Lebrun, Ange Le Doré, Joseph Dauphin (Congrégation de Jésus et Marie)

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du Vénérable Jean Eudes, tome 12, Vannes (Lafolye) et Paris (Beauchesne), 1905–1911, éd. Ch. Lebrun, A. Le Doré, J. Dauphin; transcription Bibliothèque Saint Libère (liberius.net), 2008.
sources.description: Born-digital transcription of the 1905–11 edition, converted by script: page markers and running heads removed, hyphenation and leaked letter-spacing repaired, paragraphs rejoined; the editors’ footnotes are gathered at the end of the file where they fall; footnote call numbers stay in the running text. The editors’ introductions are kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Eudes died in 1680; the 1905–11 edition is public domain.
